policy: passive — execute via websearch; never fetch unscoped URLs actively
queries: site:*.{domain} -www -www.{domain}
site:{domain} inurl:admin OR inurl:dashboard OR inurl:console
site:{domain} inurl:swagger OR inurl:openapi OR inurl:api-docs OR inurl:graphql
site:{domain} inurl:.git OR intitle:"index of" .git
site:{domain} filetype:env OR filetype:ini OR filetype:conf OR filetype:cfg
site:{domain} filetype:sql OR filetype:log OR filetype:bak OR filetype:old
site:{domain} filetype:xls OR filetype:csv OR filetype:pdf internal
site:{domain} inurl:token OR inurl:key OR inurl:secret OR inurl:password
site:{domain} inurl:upload OR inurl:filemanager OR inurl:editor
site:{domain} inurl:redirect OR inurl:next OR inurl:return OR inurl:url=
site:{domain} inurl:debug OR inurl:test OR inurl:staging OR inurl:dev
intitle:"index of" site:{domain}
site:pastebin.com OR site:ghostbin.com "{domain}" password OR token
site:github.com "{domain}" password OR api_key OR secret
site:gitlab.com OR site:bitbucket.org "{domain}"
site:trello.com OR site:atlassian.net "{domain}"
site:scribd.com OR site:slideshare.net "{domain}" internal OR confidential
"{program}" "api key" OR "authorization: bearer"
site:stackoverflow.com OR site:medium.com "{domain}" internal api
inurl:"{domain}" ext:action OR ext:aspx OR ext:jsp OR ext:php
